source_note: 把积分或求和对象视为一个计数函数并展开
english_source_note: Treating Sums or Integrals as Counting Functions
callout_id: 把积分或求和对象视为一个计数函数并展开#3
statement_en: For $\operatorname{Re}(s)>1$, define $$ \zeta(s) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^s}. $$ Prove that $$ \zeta(s) = s \int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{[x]}{x^{s+1}} \, dx .$$
key_techniques: rewrite the floor function as a counting function
integral representation of the zeta function
callout_body:
对于$\text{Re}(s)>1$，定义
$$ \zeta(s) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^s}$$
证明：$$ \zeta(s) = s \int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{[x]}{x^{s+1}} \, dx $$
